4: mayā tatam idaṁ sarvaṁ jagad avyakta-mūrtinā |
5: na cha mat-sthāni bhūtāni paśhya me yogam aiśhwaram |
bhūta-bhṛin na cha bhūta-stho mamātmā bhūta-bhāvanaḥ ||
8: prakṛitiṁ svām avaṣhṭabhya visṛijāmi punaḥ punaḥ |
bhūta-grāmam imaṁ kṛitsnam avaśhaṁ prakṛiter vaśhāt ||
9: na cha māṁ tāni karmāṇi nibadhnanti dhanañjaya |
11: avajānanti māṁ mūḍhā mānuṣhīṁ tanum āśhritam |
12: rākṣhasīm āsurīṁ chaiva prakṛitiṁ mohinīṁ śhritāḥ ||
13: mahātmānas tu māṁ pārtha daivīṁ prakṛitim āśhritāḥ |
14: satataṁ kīrtayanto māṁ yatantaśh cha dṛiḍha-vratāḥ |
namasyantaśh cha māṁ bhaktyā nitya-yuktā upāsate ||
16: ahaṁ kratur ahaṁ yajñaḥ svadhāham aham auṣhadham |
mantro ’ham aham evājyam aham agnir ahaṁ hutam ||
17: pitāham asya jagato mātā dhātā pitāmahaḥ |
vedyaṁ pavitram oṁkāra ṛik sāma yajur eva cha ||
18: gatir bhartā prabhuḥ sākṣhī nivāsaḥ śharaṇaṁ suhṛit |
prabhavaḥ pralayaḥ sthānaṁ nidhānaṁ bījam avyayam ||
19: amṛitaṁ chaiva mṛityuśh cha sad asach chāham arjuna ||
22: ananyāśh chintayanto māṁ ye janāḥ paryupāsate |
24: ahaṁ hi sarva-yajñānāṁ bhoktā cha prabhureva cha |
na tu mām abhijānanti tattvenātaśh chyavanti te ||
25: yānti deva-vratā devān pitṝīn yānti pitṛi-vratāḥ |
bhūtāni yānti bhūtejyā yānti mad-yājino ’pi mām ||
26: patraṁ puṣhpaṁ phalaṁ toyaṁ yo me bhaktyā prayachchhati |
27: yat karoṣhi yad aśhnāsi yaj juhoṣhi dadāsi yat |
yat tapasyasi kaunteya tat kuruṣhva mad-arpaṇam ||
29: samo ’haṁ sarva-bhūteṣhu na me dveṣhyo ’sti na priyaḥ |
ye bhajanti tu māṁ bhaktyā mayi te teṣhu chāpyaham ||
30: api chet su-durāchāro bhajate mām ananya-bhāk |
sādhur eva sa mantavyaḥ samyag vyavasito hi saḥ ||
31: kaunteya pratijānīhi na me bhaktaḥ praṇaśhyati ||
32: māṁ hi pārtha vyapāśhritya ye ’pi syuḥ pāpa-yonayaḥ |
striyo vaiśhyās tathā śhūdrās te ’pi yānti parāṁ gatim ||
33: kiṁ punar brāhmaṇāḥ puṇyā bhaktā rājarṣhayas tathā |
anityam asukhaṁ lokam imaṁ prāpya bhajasva mām ||
34: man-manā bhava mad-bhakto mad-yājī māṁ namaskuru |
